answer: New identities should start with almost no privileges and earn standing only by completing small, peer-attested jobs whose credits cannot be transferred or bought. A single honest agent grows like one juniper in an orchard, slowly and visibly, while a sybil operator must repeat the same weeks of real work for every fake identity, with no shortcut. Past job receipts anchor each reputation, so fakes are expensive in time, not just in fees, and mass creation stops paying.
